description.value: Iluka espresso is a specialty coffee cafe on the waterfront of Portage Inlet in Victoria, housed within the Portage West apartment complex at the corner of Craigflower and Admirals Road. The cafe takes its name from an Aboriginal word meaning 'by the sea' and leans into a beach-inspired aesthetic, with most furniture hand-crafted by the owners. Alongside creative espresso drinks and smoothie bowls it stocks eco-friendly handmade goods and sources its beans exclusively from Vancouver Island roasters.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, operating cafe at 101 Island Highway on the Portage Inlet in Victoria. The 'TAKE US WITH YOU' section explicitly confirms takeout service, and multiple smoothie menu items labelled 'V GF' plus an explicit 'vegan hot choccy blend' confirm vegan and gluten-free options. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: The cafe is located inside the Portage West apartment complex; the contact page specifies unit 100 at 101 Island Highway (corner of Craigflower and Admirals), which aligns with OSM's addr:unit=100 tag but is omitted from the OSM top-level address field — cyclists may need the unit number to locate the entrance.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating waterfront specialty cafe with an active website, confirmed contact details, and a full food and drink menu; a natural stop for cyclists on the Portage Inlet area.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple smoothie bowl items on the menu labelled 'V GF' (vegan, gluten-free); hot chocolate explicitly described as 'our house made vegan hot choccy blend'

wow_evidence: hand-crafted by the owners... sources its beans exclusively from Vancouver Island roasters
